mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) during the signal period, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings impulse.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a labor market so tight that wage inflation will soon accelerate, prompting the Fed to raise rates and depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPI inflation remains below 2% over the signal period, indicating that wage pressures are not spilling over into consumer prices and thus will not trigger a hawkish Fed response.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply crunch that will drive up costs and erode corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: ISM Manufacturing PMI rises above 60 during the signal period, indicating that the supply chain pressures are easing and will not materially impact profits.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts growth accelerates by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a boom in residential investment that will boost economic activity and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 30-year mortgage rates rise by more than 100 basis points during the signal period, indicating that financing costs will choke off the housing boom before it can boost broader economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Fed pivots to rate cuts within 6 months of the signal, indicating that the tightening cycle was transitory and will not have a lasting impact on growth.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will depress consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Initial jobless claims fall by more than 10% during the signal period, indicating that the labor market weakening is temporary and will not lead to a sustained slowdown in consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures accelerate by more than 5% year-over-year, it signals a surge in consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Consumer confidence index falls by more than 10 points during the signal period, indicating that the consumption surge is not sustainable and will reverse course.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3% and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it signals a dangerous mix of high inflation and loose monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to tighten aggressively.
failure_condition: The Fed signals a willingness to tolerate above-target inflation for an extended period, indicating that it will not tighten policy aggressively enough to derail the equity rally.
